headline: Brief Reports San Roque Dam at 268.80 Meters After Major Monsoon Recovery
seoTitle: Brief: San Roque Dam Reported at 268.80m
seoDescription: An FMB News midday brief reports San Roque Dam at 268.80 meters above sea level after a large monsoon-driven recovery.
deck: The newsroom package reports a major storage rebound at San Roque Dam.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The August 16 FMB News brief reports San Roque Dam at 268.80 meters above sea level, more than 40 meters above a late-July level, and links the recovery to irrigation security.

FMB News could not independently retrieve the corresponding August 16 PAGASA or NIA table. The 268.80-meter reading, 40-meter gain and 87,000-hectare irrigation figure therefore remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Exact August 16 level was not independently reproduced.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: San Roque supports irrigation, hydropower and flood management, making reservoir trends important for both agriculture and downstream communities.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for PAGASA dam-status tables, NIA irrigation advisories and any spillway or gate-operation notices.
